description: Reverse-ETL usage-based billing activation: send a Metronome usage event (POST /ingest) for each row of an upstream DataFrame. Batched up to 100 events per request; transaction_id is Metronome's idempotency key so retries never double-bill.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one usage event, batched up to 100 per /ingest request.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (events_sent / batches_sent / rows_skipped_no_customer_id). No downstream data -- the usage event lands in Metronome and affects the customer's invoice.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

customer_id_column.label: Customer ID Column
customer_id_column.description: Upstream column holding the Metronome customer_id (UUID) or ingest alias.

event_type.label: Event Type
event_type.description: Static event_type applied to every row. Mutually exclusive with event_type_column.

event_type_column.label: Event Type Column
event_type_column.description: Upstream column holding a per-row event_type. Mutually exclusive with event_type.

timestamp_column.label: Timestamp Column
timestamp_column.description: Upstream column holding the RFC 3339 event timestamp. Defaults to current UTC time if unset.

transaction_id_column.label: Transaction ID Column
transaction_id_column.description: Upstream column holding a stable unique-per-event ID (Metronome's idempotency key). Strongly recommended.

properties_columns.label: Properties Columns
properties_columns.description: Upstream columns to include in the event's properties object. Defaults to all non-reserved columns.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Rows per /ingest request. Metronome's hard limit is 100 events per request.

max_rows_per_run.label: Max Rows Per Run
max_rows_per_run.description: Optional blast-radius safety cap on total rows sent per materialization.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Max retry attempts per batch on network error, 5xx, or 429 before raising.

initial_backoff_seconds.description: Backoff before the first retry. Doubles (x backoff_multiplier) each subsequent attempt.
initial_backoff_seconds.label: Initial Backoff Seconds

backoff_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the backoff delay after each retry.
backoff_multiplier.label: Backoff Multiplier

name: Metronome Usage Event Send
